purpose: Reject invalid dense TSDF lattice geometry and unrepresentable field capacities before allocation; report allocator reservation failures through the existing scene error type.

fixed_contract.geometry: Require all origin components finite, existing positive finite voxel size/truncation and nonzero dimensions. Check each last voxel center with exactly the existing f32 origin + ((dim-1) as f32 + 0.5) * voxel_size expression and reject non-finite results. Positive offsets are monotonic, so finite endpoints bound all centers. Preserve finite rounded or coincident centers; no stricter spacing or physical-grid policy.
fixed_contract.capacity: Use checked dimension multiplication and reject counts above isize::MAX / size_of::<f32>() for either field before allocator access. Reserve both distance and weight vectors with try_reserve_exact before initializing either; map reservation failure into the existing InvalidConfiguration variant. No new arbitrary grid-size cap, public signature, error variant or dependency. Fallible reservation is not an operating-system overcommit, allocator abort, RSS or global memory-budget guarantee.
fixed_contract.compatibility: Preserve all volume fields, public method signatures, valid initial distance/weight values and x/y/z layout. All integration, support admission, meshing and submitted-cloud counters stay unchanged, as do core/GPU/ROS2 libraries, dependencies, explicit device ownership and physical calibration/accuracy gates.
fixed_contract.verification: Commit this protocol before native execution, then commit small invalid-geometry and safe unrepresentable-capacity regression cases with parent production unchanged. Capacity tests catch original capacity panics and only request mathematically impossible Vec capacities; never request a large representable allocation or simulate physical OOM. Preserve the failing baseline. Cover every origin axis, first/last centers, overflowing intermediate f32 offsets, product/capacity bounds, existing invalid scalars/zero shapes and accepted extreme/subnormal/tiny/non-cubic layouts. Verify all non-constructor production methods are unchanged.

verification: Use the existing bounded owned offline scene baseline, default/all-feature suites and Clippy; full-bag/E2E, ROS2/mapping/viewer all features, calibration controls, ROS2 all-target Clippy and formatting. Existing three-OS scene all-feature coverage and all 131 named CI checks gate merge. Bind each completed command and preserve every failure log. No frozen binary rebuild, sensor payload read/acquisition/copy or real-motion fit.

resources.preservation: Hash-protect prior scientific JSON, all 42 frozen native artifacts, pinned sources and completed room outputs. Reuse the cache, preserve failed logs and never rebuild frozen binaries. No real sensor read/download/copy or real-motion fit. Synthetic SQLite/JSON fixtures stay in the owned external temp directory.

remaining_80_percent: Native full-room accuracy and genuinely unobserved motion; both qualifying raw Linux hardware classes; matching canonical measured clock uncertainty and physical frame accuracy; complete canonical mapping/semantic/Viewer/interchange/release acceptance. Successful record-submission traceability does not establish these requirements.
